name: @sortsys/v2-client
description: Typed batched RPC client for sortsys-api-v2

scripts.build: bun run lint:client-casts && rm -rf dist && bun build src/index.ts --production --outfile dist/index.js && bun build src/rpc.ts --production --outfile dist/rpc.js && tsc -p tsconfig.json --emitDeclarationOnly --outDir dist --declarationDir dist && bun ./scripts/write-dist-package-json.mjs
